feature_semantics.input_characters: character length of the model-visible prompt, as emitted by the pool generator
feature_semantics.input_tokens_estimate: generator estimate, characters/4; NOT provider usage accounting
feature_semantics.entity_count: distinct synthetic entities the task must reason over
feature_semantics.dependency_depth: longest precedence chain in the task graph; 0 when not a graph task
feature_semantics.file_count: number of source artefacts supplied in the prompt
feature_semantics.tool_steps: estimated tool steps a solver would need; 0 for every required product family in this freeze

boundary_derivation.method: floor of the midpoint between the highest observed decision-feature value of a band and the lowest observed value of the next band, computed per family over the frozen pool
boundary_derivation.why_per_family: a single global cut cannot separate the bands: dependency_planning XL (471-535) sits below classification L (538)
boundary_derivation.recompute_features: disabled by design; the frozen records carry generator-owned feature values and re-deriving them here would fork the definition

change_policy: any change to classifier_id, feature_schema, decision_feature or family_bands is breaking: mint a new classifier id and a new pool freeze version
